message.content:
This quote is attributed to **Ibn Khaldun** (1332–1406), the famous Arab Muslim historian, philosopher, and social scientist from Tunisia. The full quote reads:

> **"Businesses owned by responsible and organized merchants shall eventually surpass those owned by wealthy rulers."**

This statement appears in his most famous work, the **Muqaddimah** (also known as "Prolegomena"), which is considered a foundational text in the fields of historiography, sociology, and economics. Ibn Khaldun is often regarded as one of the forerunners of modern economics, and this particular quote reflects his insights on market economies and the superiority of well-managed private enterprise over state-controlled or ruler-owned businesses.

The quote has been cited in various contexts, including discussions of Islamic economics, supply-side economic theory, and privatization policies. Some sources reference it as appearing in **Muqaddimah 2:272–73** (as cited in Weiss 1995, p. 30).
